files.item: Web-poster for the miscellaneous 2015 event series.
files.notes: Adapted from a National Federation of Women Workers banner, which is in the People's History Museum, Manchester. The design was itself adapted from the front cover of The Woman Worker magazine, March 1916, designed by Walter Crane (1845–1915).
